meta.name: senior-technical-product-evaluation
meta.description: Evaluate senior technical candidates across resume screening, interview preparation, interview-transcript review, scorecard updates, and hiring decisions. Use for CTOs, technical directors, principal engineers, architects, AI leaders, and other senior technical candidates whenever product quality, personal technical ownership, AI judgment, product/customer judgment, operating responsibility, cross-functional leadership, target-role fit, or missing evidence must be assessed and handed to later interviewers. Requires public product research, responsibility-boundary inference, stage-aware evidence handling, and an actionable validation ledger.
